title: Braised Pumpkin Tagine with Orange Zest
description: A French-inspired stew made with tender pumpkin and the warmth of citrusy spices, served with a hint of kissed sweetness.

ingredients.name: Tagine spice blend (or a mix of cinnamon, ginger, and cumin)

instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add pumpkin, spice blend, salt, and 1 cup water. Stir to combine.
Bring to a boil, then cover and transfer to the oven.
Braise for 30-40 minutes, or until pumpkin is tender.
Stir in orange marmalade and orange zest.
